## Improvements

- Logs view performance improvement (on projects and containers screens)
- Update libs

## Fixes

- #173 Cannot read property 'destroy' of undefined after latest update
- Show correct container status if the container was stopped immediately after running
- Fix update button

## New Features

- Visual editor for Compose configs
- Auth Screens
- Support YML and YAML formats
- Support custom name of compose configs
- Fix styles of UI elements
- Update related libs

## Fixes, updates, improvements...

- #44 System Docker Info
- #60 Custom arguments
- #68 Option to specify custom docker-compose.yml name
- #82 CANT USE on CENTOS 7
- #90 [tooltip] "Dockerfile seems to be invalid" although it is in fact valid
- #93 several compose files support
- #96 Improve performance for container log view
- #106 multiple docker-compose files in the same folder
- #113 Dockstation version unknown
- #114 Improve restart logic of a container
- #121 Support for build args
- #127 Dockstation looses projects list
- #132 Mixing logs between different containers
- #137 Support both .yml and .yaml extensions
- #140 unable to display container in projects tab
- #141 Support for custom compose filenames
- #152 New docker version incompatibility
- #164 Metrics section message is not in english

## Hotfixes

#110 Scheme page fixed
#109 Fixed close window bug (macOS only)
- Fixed Update system. If you are updating from v1.4.0, the app could freeze until download finishes.
- Checking news at once after app start
- Fixed styles of UI components
- Updated libs

## Features
#76 Ports Manager
#53 Can't pick image version to pull.
Added possibility to set custom Terminal emulator
Changed update system
Added "News" section for hot notify.
